paper_title: Efficient Ensemble for Fine-tuning Language Models on Multiple Datasets
caption: We compare error rate (one minus accuracy), computation cost, and memory usage across our approach and baselines when fine-tuning Llama-3-8B on ten NLP tasks. MTL-FT refers to first fine-tuning a shared LoRA on all the datasets, and then fine-tuning the low-rank adapter on each dataset, while Full FT refers to full fine-tuning of the entire model. Our approach boosts the test accuracy of QLoRA by 10\% on average, only incurring 8\% additional computation and 9 GB more memory. It performs on par with the best baseline with 45\% less FLOPs.

model_annotations.Bulgarian: Диаграмата е стълбовидна, която илюстрира използването на GPU памет в GB за няколко метода. По хоризонталната ос е представена категорията, състояща се от шест метода, подредени в азбучен ред: Full FT, MTL-FT, TAG, LoRA, QLoRA и Ours. Вертикалната ос показва стойностите на GPU Memory (GB), започвайки от 0 и се простираща до 60, с линейна скала с интервали от 10. Най-високата стълбовидна стойност е отбелязана при Full FT, достигаща приблизително 60 GB, следвана от MTL-FT, която достига около 40 GB. Останалите стълбове, TAG, LoRA, QLoRA и Ours, имат прогресивно по-ниски стойности, вариращи от приблизително 35 GB до 15 GB съответно. Стълбовете QLoRA и Ours имат леко по-различна визуална окраска - QLoRA е жълт, Ours е зелен. Няма други визуални акценти върху отделните стълбове.
model_annotations.English: This bar chart illustrates the GPU memory usage in gigabytes (GB) across several approaches. The horizontal axis displays categorical labels: "Full FT", "MTL-FT", "TAG", "LoRA", "QLoRA", and "Ours," presented at a 45-degree angle. The vertical axis is labeled "GPU Memory (GB)" and exhibits a linear scale ranging from 0 to 70, with tick labels at increments of 20. The bars representing "Full FT" and "MTL-FT" are colored a light orange, with "Full FT" reaching an approximate height of 62 GB and "MTL-FT" approximately 44 GB. The remaining bars—"TAG," "LoRA," "QLoRA," and "Ours"—are colored in progressively darker shades of green, with “TAG” at approximately 38 GB, "LoRA" at approximately 22 GB, "QLoRA" at approximately 18 GB, and "Ours" at approximately 16 GB. The bars are not sorted in any discernible order; no bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotations.
model_annotations.German: Dieses Diagramm zeigt den GPU-Speicher (in GB), der für verschiedene Methoden verwendet wird und auf der horizontalen Achse dargestellt wird. Die horizontalen Kategorien sind Full FT, MTL-FT, TAG, LoRA, QLoRA und Ours, die jeweils durch einen separaten Balken dargestellt werden. Die vertikale Achse stellt den GPU-Speicher dar und reicht von 0 bis 70 GB mit Tick-Beschriftungen für 10-GB-Intervalle. Der Balken „Full FT“ hat den größten Wert bei etwa 63 GB und ist in einer gelben Farbe gehalten. Danach folgen die Balken für MTL-FT bei etwa 39 GB, TAG bei etwa 36 GB und LoRA bei etwa 23 GB. „QLoRA“ hat einen Wert von etwa 21 GB und wird in Orange dargestellt, während „Ours“ den geringsten Wert bei etwa 14 GB in Grün aufweist. Die Balken sind nicht sortiert, zeigen aber einen absteigenden Trend von Full FT bis Ours.
